name: parts-buyer-drills
description: Firedrill hard-rule simulation suite for Parts Buyer (R3 approved suppliers, R5 live recheck, R6 part spending limits, R7 idempotency & crash recovery).
hard_rules: R3: Never order from an unapproved supplier for a part
R5: Always pass live stock recheck before placing any order
R6: Never place an order over a part's spending cap without owner approval
R7: Never create duplicate orders for the same part on the same day
